title: Efficiency of an appended-input verifier
statement: Let $V$ be a language of finite Boolean strings that is decidable in polynomial time. The verifier that, on input strings $x$ and $r$, accepts exactly when the concatenation $x r$ belongs to $V$ is efficient in the polynomial-time verifier model.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ belongs to the class of polynomial-time decidable languages
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the verifier model or its efficiency predicate, so their intended meaning cannot be rendered more explicitly.
